messages:
maria (Finance): Heads-up — I ran a reconciliation on Cumulus Labs' March dedicated invoice and found three burst line items during the EU failover window; they were billed for overage.
ajay (Billing): Drop the invoice and line items and I'll pull meter logs.
maria (Finance): INV-2026-03-CL-1123. Lines: 2026-03-12 Dedicated Reserved - CL-PROD 720h commit; 2026-03-12 Burst Overage (eu-west-1) 36.5 GPU-hrs; 2026-03-14 Burst Overage (eu-west-1) 48.0 GPU-hrs; 2026-03-15 Burst Overage (eu-west-1) 12.5 GPU-hrs.
ajay (Billing): Any evidence this was caused by provider failover vs customer traffic spike? runtime/infra alerts?
maria (Finance): Routing trace shows smart-router shifted ~13% of traffic off their dedicated pool after a hardware OOM during 03-14 02:10-04:30 UTC; requests hit shared instances for ~2h20m. Infra posted IR-2026-03-14-oom.
carmen (Sales): They pinned a model and had increased tail latency; ops triggered canary -> fallback to shared. Support ticket SR-8764 opened with customer.
billing-bot: Auto-check: SLA credit eligibility = UNKNOWN. Automated rules require full-region outage to auto-apply credit; manual review needed.
sam (Finance Manager): Two asks: (1) does contract explicitly waive charges for provider-initiated failover? (2) what's the dollar amount?
maria (Finance): Contract Sec 4.2 says eligibility is at provider discretion (not automatic). Meter rate eu-west-1 burst $12.50/GPU-hr. Total overage 97.0 hrs -> $1,212.50 estimate.
olivia (Account): Customer requesting full waiver and a joint postmortem; they cite our 99.9% dedicated SLA and lost revenue.
ajay (Billing): Metering looks correct. Policy precedent: we sometimes grant goodwill credits for provider-initiated failover. Options: full overage waiver ($1,212.50) or credit up to 30% of monthly commit (commit subtotal $45,000 -> cap $13,500). Which do we choose?
sam (Finance Manager): Show numbers (done). I lean to full waiver — it's smaller and preserves relationship. Approver?
carmen (Sales): Support full waiver + formal SLA credit note for transparency.
maria (Finance): Creating internal billing ticket BILL-14211 and attaching SR-8764. Tagging @sam for approval.
billing-bot: Created BILL-14211 and linked INV-2026-03-CL-1123 -> https://redwood.internal/billing/BILL-14211
sam (Finance Manager): Approved. Authorize one-time goodwill credit for $1,212.50. GL code: REV-CR-DED-BURST. Note: "Provider failover; customer credit approved."
olivia (Account): I'll notify the customer, offer joint postmortem with infra/product, and request permission to publish a short summary.
ajay (Billing): Will post credit memo today, include IR link and affected windows in internal memo, then mark BILL-14211 resolved after accounting entries. EOD estimate.
maria (Finance): Thanks — I'll add a follow-up to finance ops to propose clarifying subscription docs around automatic vs discretionary credits and loop in legal.
ajay (Billing): Once memo posted I'll paste memo id here and close the thread.
olivia (Account): Thanks team :pray:
